title: Embed public and Next static assets in release artifact
description: Ensure the release staging process embeds `public` and `.next/static` in the exact locations expected by the standalone server.
acceptanceCriteria: The artifact contains public assets and Next static chunks in the standalone tree
No copy operation nests `static/static` or silently ignores missing source assets
The staging process fails loudly if the build produced no standalone output or static chunks
A smoke fixture can request required JS/CSS/media paths and receive local files

steps.details: Assert that a staged artifact exposes the expected `apps/web/public` and `apps/web/.next/static` paths and rejects a nested duplicate layout.
Clear only the destination static directory, copy source assets into the standalone tree, and preserve existing public assets without source-tree dependencies.
Return a clear error when public/static/standalone output is absent or incomplete.
Run the static-path test and the existing optimization harness.

technicalNotes: The current installer already documents this failure mode: `|| true` previously hid missing static assets.
